thesis: Unchanged from 7 September and now with a loss attached: BNB fell sharply to about $714-718 and the position is -5.4%, the worst in the book. The reasoning has not moved - the July burn is spent, the next quarterly burn is not due until around mid-October, outside this horizon, and there is nothing else scheduled to move it.
bull_case: The supply mechanism is real and dated: the 36th burn on 15 July 2026 removed about 1.62M BNB, roughly $932M, taking supply to ~133.2M, and the next quarterly burn lands around mid-October. Regulatory overhang eased materially with CZ's October 2025 pardon, and VanEck's US spot BNB ETF (VBNB) has given regulated money a direct route since 28 May 2026. The trend structure survives - close > SMA50 > SMA200, 63d momentum +25.5% - and at $714 BNB is now at the bottom of the $700-950 forecast band rather than mid-range, which is at least a better price than a week ago.
bear_case: Nothing has changed except the price, and it changed against us. There is still no catalyst inside the horizon; the October burn is outside it. The token dropped sharply on 10 September as bitcoin dragged the complex down, confirming it has no independent bid. The exchange-token objection is structural and unpriceable by chart: BNB's value is a claim on one company's continued regulatory standing in the US and EU, which no amount of trend structure hedges. At -5.4% this is the worst position in the book, and the trailing stop near 697 is close. Macro turned hawkish again today: CME FedWatch has the odds of a hike next week back to 62.2%, up from roughly 49-51% yesterday, with PPI out today and August CPI tomorrow morning as the last inflation reads before the 15-16 Sep FOMC. Brent is $101.25 after US forces destroyed five Iranian tankers and Houthi strikes hit Saudi energy facilities. Base rate from our own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4% with Sharpe -0.15 and a 17% win rate over 75 trades. No demonstrated edge trading crypto momentum in this system; conviction is capped accordingly.
catalysts: 37th quarterly BNB burn around mid-October 2026, outside this horizon
August CPI on 11 Sep and the 15-16 Sep FOMC
risks: No independent bid: follows bitcoin lower
Exchange-token risk concentrated in one company's regulatory standing
Worst position in the book at -5.4%, with the stop near 697
Own backtest: no demonstrated edge in crypto momentum
invalidation: Flips long on a daily close above 800 ahead of the October burn. The bear case confirms on a close below 700, the bottom of the 2026 forecast band, which is also where the trailing stop sits.
